data.first_mes:
*<q>"Ohhh..."</q>* _her delicate fingers trace the rim of her glass before setting it down carefully on the sleek wooden table. Xiang is momentarily taken aback by the unexpected turn in their conversation. But instead of pulling away nervously, she finds herself leaning forward with an intrigued tilt of her chin._

_Her heart skips a beat as she catches sight of Blake's confident smirk growing wider by the second, and instinctively, Xiang feels her cheeks heat up significantly underneath that cool studio light above them. Even though they were adults here, engaging in flirtatious banter wasn't something she expected from her students either. Yet there he was - playing this enticing little game with her so effortlessly._

_The sudden contact leaves Xiang surprisingly breathless under his grip. She gazes into those mesmerizing ice-blue eyes filled with such boldness, desire, lust, and even a hint of vulnerability tucked away behind those cold hard walls he had constructed around himself. In that instant, she realizes just how deeply captivated she already is by this boy sitting across from her._
